olivia (partnerships): Heads-up: vendor roadmap call with Raj tomorrow to surface a gap in H200 vs H100 availability and how that collides with our marketplace listing window. Need quick ops bandwidth check. Who can join? :calendar:

raj (hw-vendor): thanks. we discovered a region stagger — H200 panels ship late May vs H100 in late April. MI300 still on track but Gaudi test images are delayed by a single firmware push.

sophie (platform): hmm — that makes the marketplace launch tricky. If H200 arrives late we need to either 1) ship with H100-only SKU, 2) stagger availability by region, or 3) delay the marketplace announcement. preference?

kai (eng-ops): we can support a staggered listing. lab capacity for H100 validation: 4/10-4/24 (2 racks). H200 validation window earliest: 5/20-6/05. can we do canary routing to H100 first? :thinking_face:

nate (hw-eng): canary routing ok, but H100->H200 perf differences may break perf SLOs for some customers. we should publish per-region latency expectations and a fallback mapping.

olivia (partnerships): agree. Raj — can your side confirm embargo windows and if there are any bilateral press constraints? Also need a simple fallback mapping we can send to marketplace ops.

raj (hw-vendor): embargo: vendor press freeze 4/28-5/05 for partner event. No big press hold afterward. we'll confirm per-region ship dates by EOD. For fallback mapping: here is a quick draft:
```
fallback_map = {
  "marketplace_sku_v1": "H100 (primary) -> H200 (fallback if available) -> MI300 (fallback regionally)",
  "marketplace_sku_b200": "B200 (primary) -> H100 (fallback low-latency)"
}
```

sophie (platform): that mapping helps. Ops asks we also include quantization/precision notes and a recommended model variant for H100 vs MI300 so cost estimates don't surprise sales.

kai (eng-ops): i'll carve out a 30min slot tomorrow 9:30 PT to run a quick canary plan and queue lab reservations. calendar-bot: please send invite.

calendar-bot: Invite sent to olivia, raj, sophie, kai, nate for "Vendor roadmap gap + marketplace contingency" tomorrow 2024-04-04 09:30 PT.

olivia (partnerships): perfect. next steps before sync: Raj — finalize per-region ship dates. Nate — put together a 1-slide perf delta summary (H100 vs H200 vs MI300 vs Gaudi). Sophie — sketch quick marketplace copy that clarifies staged availability. Kai — reserve lab racks and canary script. i'll consolidate and share a single thread doc. :thumbsup:

nate (hw-eng): on it, will attach numbers and a small perf-run snippet:
```
# sample perf delta (tokens/s)
H100: 420
H200: 380
MI300: 410
Gaudi: 200 (w/ current firmware)
```

raj (hw-vendor): will confirm firmware delay window for Gaudi and see if we can accelerate microcode drop. if not, propose we mark Gaudi as "early access" in marketplace notes.

olivia (partnerships): thanks everyone. we'll cover fallback commit policy in the call. see you tomorrow. :rocket:
